entities.name: PMID:27497058
observations: A 3-D aortic VIC hydrogel/bioreactor study found osteogenic conditions disrupted contractility and collagen organization; RhoA inhibition reduced pro-osteogenic signaling and calcific nodules.

entities.name: RhoA-dependent VIC calcification
observations: In cultured aortic VICs, osteogenic conditions increased RhoA alongside contractile and collagen-matrix disorganization and calcific nodules; RhoA inhibition reduced pro-osteogenic signaling and nodule formation. This supports a direct in-vitro contribution, not proof of an in-vivo universal mechanism.

entities.name: PMID:26947381
observations: A 3-D tunable-stiffness human VIC culture study found matrix stiffening promoted osteogenic markers; temporally restoring stiffness or inhibiting RhoA/ROCK delayed osteogenic differentiation.

entities.name: PMID:31442470
observations: In human mitral VICs, cyclic stretch induced profibrotic CTGF signaling through RhoC/ROCK/MRTF-A and Erk1/2; RhoA silencing did not mediate the response.
